# Shared packages - safe to install on EVERY machine.
#
# This file is curated by hand and is never regenerated by sync-dotfiles.sh.
# It must stay the strict intersection of what all machines already have,
# so that no machine can ever push a package the others cannot install.
# Hardware-specific drivers (nvidia-*, intel-*, amd-ucode, vulkan-*, lib32-*)
# and games belong in the per-host files, never here.
